proposedOperation.actor: authenticated product session, never body principal

response.emptyResult: cancelled original candidate; never an empty publishable catalog

proposedOperation.permission: candidate-cancel, current tenant/app/source and four-role ceiling; import separately required for trusted row binding
proposedOperation.replay: same actor/operation/body returns durable response; changed body conflicts; COMMIT_UNKNOWN preserves preview until replay
proposedOperation.oldDelete: unchanged and not granted to intake_business; successor consumer must migrate explicitly

trustedParserStage.validatedRecovery: frozenMedia exposes only job result exact row/media payload descriptors; validated jobs also expose own pendingPayloads for guarded redundant-payload cleanup; original freeze state/material/registration digest checks still apply
trustedParserStage.authority: current import; actor and job bound; complete material/row/media registration in one transaction
trustedParserStage.publication: AFTER INSERT statement projection on release_lineage; exact row mapping and persisted payload required; immutable release media
trustedParserStage.byteTrust: Server parser validates actual bytes; SQL validates source, version, metadata hashes and complete row provenance; no arbitrary HTTP material input

invariants: new version resets source evidence and quality
only exclusive unused media is discarded; shared media survives
unbound old candidates fail closed and require reimport
same content version never restores deleted rows; new version reuse preserves immutable deletion history
no automatic expiry or physical object deletion
